lines: I was lazing away at home to my heart's content.
It had been one hard mission after the other lately, so I thought I'd at least take it easy on a day off.
But as it turned out, having nothing to do like this was boring.
The young Sakura, who was a handy playing partner in times like this, was also not at home since she had gone out to search for a part-time job.
(It is what it is. Guess I'll go to Inageya to have an ice cream and kill some time.)
Gosha Village was a small settlement.
Just by talking a random walk, you'd usually bump into some familiar facesー
On this day as well, shortly after walking out the door I ran into some of the regular crew.
Aieeeeee!! S-Stop it, Hebiko!! This is a human rights violatioooon!!
What are you talking about. The one who asked to do special training was you, Shikanosuke-chan, no?
What are you guys up to?
For some reason Hebiko had changed into an octopus and Shikanosuke was tangled in her tentacles.
This was a town of Taimanin so it was fine, but if they did something like this elsewhere it would cause an uproar.
Ah, Fuma-chan. Are you going out?
Yeah, just taking a walk. There's no mission today, so I'm chilling.
H-Hey!! Help me, Fumaaa!! Hebiko is going on about doing special training and won't let me goooo!?
Shikanosuke was still in the tentacles' clutches and pleaded to me, half in tears.
Yeah, voluntary training. There had been lots of difficult missions lately, right?
So Hebiko and Shikanosuke-chan talked about how Heberybody should improve their skills.
Just recently, I'd had a near-death experience as well.
Very admirable, Shikanosuke. You're so motivated.
I-I am motivated, buuuut~... On my day off I want to relax at home...
No chance~ Shikanosuke-chan, this is something you brought up on your own, so you have to train hard.
If you open your mouth, you're bound to put your foot in it.
You can't blurt something out without thinking in front of the diligent Hebiko.
Will you join the training, Fuma-chan?
No, I'll pass. I had a bad experience just the other day.
That's true. Alright, next time then.
W-Wait a second!? Why is Fuma exempt from the trainiiiing~!?
Fuma-chan just got out of the hospital, didn't he? Come on, let's go, Shikanosuke-chan.
Still entangled in Hebiko's octopus tentacles, Shikanosuke was being dragged away toward the academy.
As I arrived at Inageya, an elderly lady was arguing with someone at the storefront.
Hmm... even if you say that...
That's not what this is about. We are a business, that's what you have to understand.
What? You don't even know what that means? Where do I even start with you...
I had started to get a little intrigued, so I called out to them.
Oh, the young Fuma. This girl said that she wanted to eat some of our ice cream.
I took a look at the girl who had talked with the elderly lady from Inageya.
She was small but very cute. I had never seen her around here.
Is it sold out or something like that?
No, that's not it. It's just that she says she doesn't have any money.
Then there was no way she could buy any.
I do a mission instead, not money. I work hard.
Even if you say so, there's nothing for you to do today.
On weekdays, Inageya was usually busy with Gosha students on their way home, but today was a day off.
Obviously, the elderly lady wasn't busy.
Ice cream... I can't eat it? Ice cream here is tasty, I heard...
The girl said with a slightly sad voice.
She spoke broken Japanese, and she didn't seem to be from Japan, so where did she come from?
Hmm... You'll wear me down if you make that face at me.
Look, Young Fuma, won't you buy one for her?
For some reason it had become my responsibility.
Everyone knows the head of the Fuma Clan is rich. You must receive quite a big allowance, right?
Ugh!? N-No, my allowance is really...
It was such a sad amount that I couldn't even tell other people.
(Ugh!? Why is she looking at me like that!?)
The girl looked up at me with eyes that clearly expected something.
I think demonstrating your generosity here would be a way to show her what type of man you are.
Little one, you want to eat some of our ice cream, right?
Then tell him, "Please, handsome onii-chan, buy me one."
Please, handsome onii-chan, buy me one.

No, not like that. A bit more seductivelyー
"Uhuhun♪ Please, onii-chan, buy me one♪" Like this.
Uhuhun. Please, onii-chan, buy me one.
That sounded almost the same though... And what are you even teaching to a girl like this?
Come now, it's just the basics of Carnal Jutsu. No man hates a being begged by a cute girl, heehee.
Come to think of it, it was said that back in the day, the elderly lady from Inageya had been renowned as a skillful Carnal Jutsu user.
But now she was just a shriveled old lady, no matter how you looked at her.
Oh well, no way out of this I guess. One ice cream, please.
Thank you! Only one is fine?
(I just don't have enough money, damn it!!)
We sat side by side on a bench in front of the store. She alone was stuffing her face with ice cream.
She seemed very pleased with Inageya's ice cream.
Her eyes twinkled with delight, almost as if she was eating ice cream for the first time in her life.
Glad to hear it. If you had said it tasted bad, I'd have been bummed as the one who bought it for you.
The girl answered while licking her ice cream.
That name... so you're a foreigner. Where did you come from?
It looked like she was alone.
She didn't seem to be at an age where she required chaperoning, but just looking at her, leaving her alone didn't seem safe.
Gosha Village was a place where Taimanin, and anybody who had the talent to become a Taimanin, lived.
Among them, there were apparently ninja who had traveled overseas long ago, and so there were some Taimanin who looked 100% foreign.
Was she one of those foreign Taimanin?
Did you come from overseas? Were you called here for a mission or something like that?
But, how can you not remember that? To start with, you came to this store because you heard about the ice cream from someone, right?
Hmm... Perhaps... you don't understand Japanese well?
Aah, okay okay. Your ice cream is gonna melt. Eat it quickly.
As Clear continued to eat her ice cream, we lapsed into silence.
She didn't seem like the type to talk on her own, and I also didn't know what to talk about when meeting a girl like her for the first time.
However, watching Clear happily devour her ice cream had made me crave some again as well.
(*Sigh* I know how good this ice cream is...)
(If I only had a little bit more of an allowance... Maybe I should look for a part-time job together with Sakura...?)
As I looked at her, Clear was holding out her ice cream toward me.
Just a little. Your face says you want ice cream.
Haha, you're pretty nice. Then I'll take you up on that.
I took a bite of the ice cream that Clear was holding out.
Mmmmmm!! Oh man, Inageya's ice cream is good!! Right!?
Right after my bite, Clear pulled back the ice cream.
What's wrong? Let me eat some more.
I paid for it. So I have a right to eat it!
When I tried to eat some more of the ice cream, she resisted in a fuss.
Just as fooling around with Clear was starting to get interesting, a surprised-sounding voice came from behind us.
H-Hey, Fuma!? What are you doing!?
It was one of my classmates, Mizuki Yukikaze.
Previously, we hadn't had much contact, but recently a bunch of stuff had happened and we were talking often.
Don't give me that, "Oh, it's you"!? Are you... Are you on a date with such a little girl!?
I just bought an ice cream for her. She said she didn't have any money, and Inageya's elderly lady got me to buy her one.
I mean, I just met her earlier, so there's no way we'd be on a date or anything.
That's it? Ahh, you scared me... I thought you might be "shopping in the kids section"!
I'm not. What does that mean anyway?
A mysterious turn of phrase had appeared suddenly.
I-If it wasn't like that, then never mind. Um... I'm sorry for suddenly yelling, little girl.
Yukikaze spoke to Clear with a kind look, completely differently from how she had addressed me.
However, Clear seemed to be wary of Yukikaze for some reason and quickly hid behind me.
Eh!? Wh-What...? Did I do something weird...?
It's just how you are. Little girls like her can detect your vicious personality with a glance.
What do you mean "vicious"!? I'm gonna kick your ass, stupid Fuma!!
Ahh!? I-I'm sorry... I yelled again...
Yukikaze seemed to have given up due to the fact that matter how much she coaxed Clear, the girl wouldn't drop her guard.
She let out a long sigh and turned to face me again.
By the way, what are you doing in a place like this?
Me? I just took a walk. Today is a day off and I don't have any mission to go on.
Hmm... How nice, I guess dunces have a lot of free time.
I was heading to the academy now.
The academy? On a day off?
Yes. I have business with Asagi-senseiー
Asagi-sensei... Isn't she away from Gosha right now because of some government-related work?
Asagi-sensei was the headmistress of Gosha Academy and the leader of Gosha's Taimanin.
And because of that position, she often had to go to meetings with government bigwigs.
Yeah. But it seems that she'll be back soon... so I wanted to talk to her directly once more
(Come to think of it... she did bring something up with Asagi-sensei before...)
Did it have something to do with her mother who was rumored to be missing?
...And as that though crossed my mind, Yukikaze quickly turned around.
But I still have some time, so maybe I'll take a quick detour!
Oh, Yukikaze-chan. You look lively today as usual!
And off they went inside Inageya.
She's always so noisy... But she's not a bad person, so don't worry about it.
Clear kept a fairly close eye on Yukikaze's back as she entered the store.
And then hastily ate the rest of her ice cream and stood up.
That's good to hear. Next time bring your own money. Bye then.
As I said that, Clear had been starting to leave but came back as if she had suddenly thought of something.
And then for some reason she lightly grabbed my hand.
I want to be together. A bit more.
W-Well... I'm not busy today. I don't mind, but I don't have any more money to buy things for you.
(Quite an odd one has taken a liking to me...)
When I stood up, Clear began to walk briskly as if she had been waiting for that.
But she spun around again after having only taken a few steps.
Right, guess I haven't told you yet. I'm Fuma, Fuma Kotaro.
So you're not going to add "-san" or anything.
I thought "Sheesh" as I gave a wry smile and followed Clear away from the Inageya storefront.
At a hill in Gosha villageー
It was a beautiful hill where seasonal flowers bloomed all year round, and it was a popular spot in the secluded village.
Isn't this a nice spot? Taking a nap here feels really good.
I was low on funds and I also wasn't sure what kind of place a girl like Clear would like.
That was why I had brought her to this hill, one of my favorite places.
Clear's innocent joy at seeing the flowers made me, already in quite deep, feel a hint of danger.
It hadn't been my intention... but I was basically dragging around a seemingly innocent girl as much as I wanted.
It was possible someone looking at us from the outside might immediately call the police...?
Y-You... don't you have to call home or anything?
I was getting a bit worried, so I asked Clear.
Ah, I mean if you wander around like this, your parents will worry about you, won't they?
(And in the worst case scenario where her parents found us, I might get arrested!!)
I hadn't seen anything that looked like her contacting someone... Maybe she texted them?
Yes. A little more is okay. They said.
I wasn't totally convinced. But if she had contacted her parents, maybe there was no problem?
Now is free time. So... I want to play with Fuma.
Hmm, I'm not really sure, but... maybe this is also one of those situations where I can show what type of man I am? Guess it can't be helped, I'll hang out with you.
Oh!? Look what I found, let's play with this!
I picked up a frisbee that someone seemed to have forgotten and turned toward Clear.
It's a toy. It might be more fun than playing tag.
I threw the frisbee toward Clear who was tilting her head.
Not at all. It's a kind of game. Don't dodge it, catch it and throw it back.
You don't know it? It's a frisbee.
Maybe kids these days didn't play with toys like this?
Slightly feeling the generation gap, I picked up the frisbee that had fallen to the ground.
When I threw the frisbee a bit more gently than before, Clear easily caught it and threw it back to me.
The frisbee flew so fast that it seemed to cut through the air.
As I reflexively dodged out of the way, Clear asked curiously.
Well, I was just a bit surprised...

It had been completely unexpectedー
such a blistering fastball coming back at me
I picked up the frisbee that had landed behind me and threw it to Clear again.

It was the same amazing speed as beforeー
but this time I knew what was coming, so I somehow managed to catch it.
Hahaha!! Did you see how good I am?!
I threw it back to Clear again, and she caught it and returned it.
After we repeated this a few times, Clear slowly began to smile.
Clear was getting the hang of it, and I frantically caught the disc that had already reached inhuman speeds.
(D-Damn it! This girl's athletic ability is terrifying...!)
Clear was enjoying herself with a big smile on her face, while I had to do my best to keep the rally going.
Even though I was among the lowest class of Taimanin, I was still able to move quicker than a normal person, but stillー
A-Alright! ーAaahh, sorry Clear! I screwed that up!
I had misjudged my power and thrown the disc to a ridiculous height.
To a height of several meters that surely would have been impossible for a normal person.
After catching the disc and landing softly, Clear asked me while tilting her head.
...Having been shown something like this, I couldn't help but notice.
The suspicion that I had been feeling was confirmed.
ーClear was somehow abnormal. She was definitely not a normal human being.
If she was just a foreign Taimanin that I didn't know... then there would be no problem.
Just who was this girl and what had she come to Gosha for...?
Clear's face snapped upward with a jolt.
Yukikaze, who we had run into earlier, had also been saying that Asagi-sensei should be back soon.
I deliver. The thing in my belly...
In your belly? What on earth are you talking about...?
She just looked down with a sad face. And then...

I stretched out my hand to hold Clear backー
but she smoothly evaded me.
A strange mechanical whirr was followed by a blade materializing in her right hand and a shield-like object in her left.
Judging by what Clear had said just nowー
I've got a bad feeling about this!! Clear, wait!!
Damn it!! There's that ridiculous athleticism!!
I, too, was running as fast as I could, but I wasn't even close to catching up with her.
Within just a few moments, I lost sight of Clear's back as she went aheadー
And shortly after, the screams of crowd of people and the sound of battle could be heard faintly from the direction of Gosha Academy.
(That girl... was her target really Asagi-sensei!?)
Haah... haah... I'm finally here, but this is...
A fierce battle had already broken out at the main entrance of the academy.
Clear was trying to invade the academy and the Taimanin standing guard were trying to stop her.
Clear was squeezing a Taimanin she had grabbed with strength that was unthinkable from looking at her.
As if I'd say! Don't look down on us Taimanin, invader!
Clear spoke without emotion and threw the Taimanin aside.
The body of the Taimanin went flying with ease, like a piece of trash, and caved in the side of a brick flower bed with a crash.
It was a glimpse of Clear's power, which she had already shown when playing with the frisbee.

It was on par with that of Taimaninー
no, it might have even been stronger than the power of Taimanin.
And despite the situation, no emotion could be seen on Clear's face.
It was a cold-heartedness totally unlike the girl who had been playing just earlier.
Yukikaze, Hebiko, and Shikanosuke were also among the people fighting against Clear.
Yukikaze fired her lightning guns in irritationー
But this attack was also blocked completely by the shield Clear was holding.
Oh come on!! That shield is in the way!!
Hebiko will blind her with her octopus ink like always! Shikanosuke-chan, locate her please!
Same as usual, Hebiko would create a smokescreen with her octopus ink and Shikanosuke would locate the enemy with his sonar.
Ahh!? That won't work!! Hebiko, wait a second!!
For some reason Shikanosuke tried to stop her, but it was already too late.
Hebiko unleashed her octopus ink in the direction of Clearー
Accompanied by her emotionless utterance, a light had radiated from the shield Clear was holdingー
And as soon as the light touched Hebiko's octopus ink, the ink evaporated in a flash.
Ahh... But that might have been for the best...?
Shikanosuke-chan, what do you mean by that!?
I-It's because of that... that blade and shield!!
Shikanosuke pointed at Clear's blade and shield which were emitting an odd white light.
Weird particles are coming out from her equipment. They're jamming my sonar!!
If you shoot your ink like always, even I won't be able to see!!
Clear approached Hebiko and Shikanosuke, who were panicking since their usual tactic wasn't working.
(Ahh, come on!! What are you doing?!)
Stop it, Clear!! Don't do anything to them!!
She turned towards me and tilted her head with a curious look.
Yukikaze took advantage of the opening and fired her lightning guns.
Deadly lightning projectiles were flying at Clear's back.
I quickly jumped towards Clear, hugging her to push her out of the way of Yukikaze's attack.
What are you doing!? Fuma, what the hell are you thinking!?
Shut up! I don't know what's going on either!!
I wanted no part of getting in the way of Yukikaze's crazy powerful lightning projectiles.
But my body had moved by reflex.
Huh!? That girl is an assassin!! She's after Asagi-sensei!!
I know!! But she ate ice cream with me just a little while ago!!
So what!!? Get out of the way!! Or do you want to get shot!?
Damn it!! What the hell are you saying!!?
While Yukikaze and I had this back and forth, Clear was just staring at us with emotionless eyes.
...!? N-No... wrong. Fuma is not Taimanin...
A device-like thing that was attached to the top of her head was flickering.
No... not attack Fuma... He has... no Ninja Art...
Clear's body convulsed as if she had been run through with a blade and thenー
Clear pushed me off of her with tremendous force. She stood up, and the glimmer of free will in her eyes had completely disappeared.
...K I L L... A L L...
Don't, Fuma!! We have to fight her!!!
Clear's blade turned toward us, settling on its target as we shouted at each other.
